map.皮尔逊相关系数 r 用两变量离差乘积之和除以各自离差平方和之积的平方根，衡量线性: The Pearson correlation coefficient r is the sum of the products of the deviations divided by the square root of the product of the sums of squared deviations, measuring the strength and direction of a linear relation: r ranges from -1 to 1, the larger the absolute value the stronger the linear relation, and the sign indicates positive or negative correlation. r = 0 means no linear relation.
